name: GPU Reset & Gluon All-Gather Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main, master ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main, master ]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-gluon-all-gather:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, gpu, mi325x]
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10"]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python and UV
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          uv sync --all-extras
          # Ensure ROCm/Triton/Gluon specific dependencies are available
          # Assuming these are managed via pyproject.toml/requirements.txt
          uv pip install pytest pytest-xdist

      - name: Reset GPU State
        run: |
          # Ensure clean GPU state before running tests
          # This mimics the 'gpu-reset' intent by clearing caches and resetting devices
          rm -rf ~/.cache/triton
          rm -rf ~/.cache/gluon
          
          # Optional: Reset GPU memory if a specific utility is available in the environment
          # rocm-smi --reset || true

      - name: Run Gluon All-Gather Tests
        env:
          ROC_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7"
          NCCL_DEBUG: "INFO"
          TRITON_INTERP: "0"
        run: |
          # Run the specific test suite for Gluon all-gather
          # Using torchrun to simulate multi-GPU environment if required by the test harness
          # Assuming the test file is test_all_gather_gluon.py as per the request
          
          # Check if the test file exists, if not, run general ccl tests
          if [ -f "test_all_gather_gluon.py" ]; then
            torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest test_all_gather_gluon.py -v -s
          else
            # Fallback to running all ccl tests if specific file is missing
            torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest tests/ -k "all_gather" -v -s
          fi

      - name: Verify No Regression on Triton Tests
        env:
          ROC_VISIBLE_DEVICES: "0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7"
          NCCL_DEBUG: "INFO"
        run: |
          # Run existing Triton all-gather tests to ensure no regression
          torchrun --nproc_per_node=8 -m pytest tests/ -k "all_gather and not gluon" -v -s

  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python and UV
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-uv@main
        with:
          python-version: "3.10"
          enable-cache: true

      - name: Install linting dependencies
        run: |
          uv sync --all-extras
          uv pip install ruff mypy

      - name: Run Ruff
        run: |
          ruff check .

      - name: Run MyPy
        run: |
          mypy .
